title: CROSS_BORDER_CHINA_GROUND_TRUTH_EXECUTION_ROUTING
formation_definition: Remote overseas principals repeatedly reach a time-sensitive decision that cannot be resolved digitally and need a bounded physical action or evidence bundle in China. Replaceable China-local executors can perform the scoped task; the operator owns scope normalization, dispatch, evidence acceptance, buyer communication and settlement.
not_the_formation: Reddit lead generation as the business model
professional certification or engineering audit without qualified specialists

observed_demand_evidence.observation: Overseas buyer asked for a local person to verify an Alibaba manufacturer, confirm stock/quality, and return photos/videos before a larger order.
Buyer sought a China-side partner for factory finding, supplier verification, samples, QC, logistics and on-ground support.
A September 2026 one-time on-site production verification job in China carried a $200 fixed budget and required live video, production proof and a quick report.
A $100 trial showroom visit required photos/video, dimensions, prices, MOQ and supplier information, with explicit potential for monthly repeat work.
A $100 bounded site audit required a physical visit, photos and a predefined report, showing the same mechanism outside sourcing.
A $525 Shanghai field-research assignment paid per visited shop for photographic inventory evidence.

observed_executor_supply_and_standardiza.observation: Chinese platform describes task decomposition by address/time/photo requirements, local-person matching, evidence QA and privacy processing; public worker reference compensation is RMB30-80 for basic photo tasks and RMB80-200 for short-video/multi-point tasks.
Commercial service explicitly sells defined local task execution in China with scope, location, evidence needs and completion reporting.
Service positions itself as overseas clients' local hands and eyes for site execution, supplier communication, inspection and purchasing support.

market_price_signals.observation: Observed same-family one-off buyer budgets include $100 and $200 tasks; scope varies materially.
Public professional pricing lists factory inspection at $299 per session.
Public professional pricing lists live factory visits from $899; this is a higher-trust/higher-service tier and not directly comparable to a simple field task.

key_reasoning: The demand is not inferred from a trend: current buyers publicly ask for and pay for local China execution.
Factory verification is only one manifestation. The same structure appears in showroom evidence, retail surveys, test-center audits, trade-show/factory coordination and sample/QC work.
The scarce value is not generic information. It is lawful physical presence plus standardized evidence while the buyer's decision window is still open.
A general AI agent cannot physically inspect a site; however the operator must own dispatch/QA/acceptance rather than become a permanent field worker.
Existing incumbents validate the category but also mean 'generic China helper' is not sufficient differentiation.

bootstrap_boundary.buyer_money_before_local_execution: REQUIRED via platform escrow or legitimate prepayment arrangement
bootstrap_boundary.customer_acquisition_for_first_transacti: May use already-published self-revealing demand; do not manufacture demand with friends/family or paid traffic.
bootstrap_boundary.executor_sourcing_for_first_transactions: May be manual, but every manual step must be logged as a future replaceable dispatch function.

decisive_unknowns: Can a buyer be converted from already-self-revealed demand to prepayment/escrow before the operator incurs local execution cost?
Can a replaceable local executor complete the same standardized evidence brief without the founder visiting the site?
After paying executor, travel, payment/platform fees, rework and QA, is normalized contribution margin still positive?
Can the operator acquire subsequent demand without recurring high-touch founder persuasion?
Which task classes stay bounded and evidence-based rather than becoming expert sourcing/negotiation/technical certification?
adjacent_task_classes_to_search_next: trade-fair booth proxy and supplier evidence collection
retail shelf and local market surveys
bounded institutional/site compliance observation using client-provided checklist
kill_conditions: Every customer requires bespoke sales persuasion rather than self-revealed intent.
Every job requires a new specialist rather than a replaceable general field executor.
The operator must personally travel or interpret expert facts for every delivery.
Access/filming permissions make standardized evidence impossible.
Normalized margin is non-positive after replacing founder free labor with market cost.
Disputes or liability require the operator to guarantee facts beyond observable evidence.
